title: Evacuation begins from ravaged Russian-controlled Ukrainian city

blocks.text: KYIV, Ukraine – The evacuation of stranded residents in Oleshky, a ravaged Ukrainian frontline city under Russian occupation, was beginning on Friday as part of a US-brokered ceasefire, officials from both Russia and Ukraine said.
